# Right Steps Academy

> Licensed preschool and daycare in Fort Myers, Florida (Lee County) for children 12 months through VPK.

- Address: 12800 Kenwood Ln, Fort Myers, FL 33907
- Phone: 239-318-1102
- Hours: Monday–Friday 7:00am–6:00pm; closed weekends and holidays
- Ages: 12 months through VPK (age 4 by September 1). Kindergarten coming soon.
- Tuition: $1,100 per 4-week period (Toddlers, Two's, Three's); $800 per 4-week period VPK Wraparound. Breakfast, lunch and afternoon snack included.
- VPK: Florida's free Voluntary Prekindergarten plus full-day wraparound care
- Curriculum: play-based, inquiry-based, STEAM, small groups, character development
- Florida DCF license: C20LE0270
- Florida Gold Seal Quality Care provider
- APPLE accredited (Accredited Professional Preschool Learning Environment, Florida Association for Child Care Management)
